points.statement: The work provides a simulation platform for studying multi-agent collaboration through natural language in rich, embodied scenarios.
points.quote: a simulation platform for studying multi-agent collaboration through natural language in rich, embodied scenarios

points.statement: The platform is easily extensible and enables language-model agents to control characters in an open-world game.
points.quote: an easily extensible platform built to enable LLM agents to control characters in the open-world game of Minecraft

points.statement: A benchmark tests multiple dimensions of embodied and collaborative reasoning.
points.quote: a benchmark to test the different dimensions of embodied and collaborative reasoning

points.statement: Collaborative agents need to communicate efficiently and continuously learn and adapt during real-world embodied tasks.
points.quote: ensuring their ability to efficiently and effectively communicate with collaborators and continuously learn and adapt throughout this process in real-world embodied tasks
